title: streptanthus glandulosus subsp. sonomensis
intro: Streptanthus glandulosus subsp. sonomensis, commonly known as Sonoma jewelflower, is a species of flowering plant in the mustard family, native to the coastal scrub and chaparral of northern California. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sonoma jewelflower include wound healing, antimicrobial effects, and possibly anticancer properties due to the presence of bioactive constituents. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids.
